QUESTION ONE: Prose

Read the passage provided (Text A — a short story about two neighbours who gradually form an unlikely bond over a shared fence).

Analyse how the writer shows us the way small gestures can build trust between strangers.

Support your answer with evidence from the text.

Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, presenting a reasoned discussion of one or more ideas. Show awareness of deliberate crafting for a particular purpose. Look for: how initial suspicion gives way to curiosity and warmth; how everyday objects (a plate of baking, a borrowed tool) take on symbolic weight; how dialogue shifts from polite formality to genuine openness; how setting details (the fence, the weather) mirror the emotional distance or closeness between characters.
